metadata.title: Apache Maven Dataset Suitability & Technical Blocker Report

identifiedBlockers.name: Windows MAX_PATH File Creation Failure in Worktree
identifiedBlockers.impact: 100% of parent revisions fail checkout during getOrBuildHistoricalGraph
identifiedBlockers.detail: Git worktree checkout fails with 'fatal: cannot create directory at its/core-it-suite/src/test/resources/mng-6759-...: Filename too long'. The harness caught this and logs E_HISTORICAL_GRAPH_FAILED, resulting in 0 valid evaluation cases unless core git configuration is modified.

identifiedBlockers.name: Duplicate FQN Overwriting Across Multi-Module Subdirectories
identifiedBlockers.impact: 179 components silently overwritten; ground truth corrupted
identifiedBlockers.detail: javaAnalyzer uses packageName.ClassName as component ID. In Maven, test mocks in its/core-it-suite/ share identical package and class names with production classes (e.g. CoreItMojo, TouchMojo), overwriting production components in componentsMap and pointing filePaths to dummy test resources.

identifiedBlockers.name: Plexus / Guice / Sisu Architecture vs Spring Regex Analyzer
identifiedBlockers.impact: 39.0% of components classified as 'Other'; inter-module dependencies missed
identifiedBlockers.detail: Maven uses Plexus (@Component, @Requirement) and JSR-330 / Sisu (@Named, @Inject) instead of Spring. The AST analyzer is optimized for Spring annotations, leaving architectural relationships largely unextracted.

identifiedBlockers.name: Uncached Graph Construction Scaling
identifiedBlockers.detail: Because Maven contains 3,280 Java files, relationship extraction requires hundreds of thousands of dynamic regex matches per class, making sequential parent graph reconstruction computationally prohibitive without architectural pruning.
